contextual_model.cross_round_update: Gaussian rank-one correction-regression update for the three online methods
contextual_model.drift_diagnostic: standardized residuals logged; no test-tuned threshold
contextual_model.within_round_update: posterior conditions on every queried observation

method_definitions.Contextual-KG: two KG-selected queries; posterior conditions within each round, but correction regression resets to the calibration fit at each round
method_definitions.IVR-Online: common sentinel plus one IVR-selected query; correction regression updates persist across rounds
method_definitions.PIVOT-KG-Loop-v2: common sentinel plus one KG-selected query; correction regression updates persist across rounds
method_definitions.Static-PIVOT-KG-v1: two KG-selected queries under the original narrow-state static calibration prior; legacy reference
method_definitions.Top-Proxy-Online: common sentinel plus one proxy-ranked query; correction regression updates persist across rounds

sentinel_rule: candidate_index = round_id mod 4; one common-rule sentinel plus one method-specific query
terminal_rule: posterior mean over incumbent plus four candidates
